comment: Each listed verdict compares the exact byte-pinned source-anchor bundle and explicitly pinned semantic context with Lean's fully expanded paper-local semantic target and Lean-elaborated parameter, premise, and conclusion roles. The paired proof endpoint is reviewed separately.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.general_lower_bo.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:59-65 (Theorem 1, General Lower Bound) and Setting (source-audited.tex:51-58) under approved source model convention SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 against the expanded Lean target for general_lower_boundSpec and all 12 supporting declarations (FinDist, FinDist.tail, FinDist.rev, SREV, Profile, prob, value, bundleTail, BREV, Mechanism, Mechanism.rev, REV). The supporting definitions faithfully formalize finite nonnegative distributions (with prob_sum = 1 ruling out empty support), independent product profiles, and well-bounded real suprema for SREV/BREV/REV over p >= 0 and all IC+IR direct mechanisms on nonnegative valuation vectors. The spec existentially quantifies m : Nat and D : Fin m -> FinDist and asserts both the strict inequality 2.1946 * max (SREV D) (BREV D) < REV D and a witnessing deterministic Mechanism (Fin m) (alloc v i = 0 or 1 for all v, i) satisfying 2.1946 * max (SREV D) (BREV D) < M.rev D, matching every quantifier, domain, constant, and conclusion of Theorem 1.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.iid100_lower_bou.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:90-92 (Proposition 5, 100-item i.i.d. Exact Rational Bound) and Setting (source-audited.tex:51-58) under SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 against the expanded Lean target for iid100_lower_boundSpec and all 12 supporting declarations. The integer-support clause (every F.val i is a natural number) together with F.tail k = 3 / (25 * max k 4) for 1 <= k <= 13 and F.tail k = 0 for k > 13 uniquely pins down the probability law of the discrete random variable X on {0, ..., 13}, and because SREV, BREV, REV, and M.rev depend only on the law of F, the existential formulation over F is equivalent to existence plus universal validity for every FinDist realizing that law. For the 100 i.i.d. copies (fun _ : Fin 100 => F), the witnessing deterministic Mechanism (Fin 100) has the exact seller-favorable two-part tariff payment rule (entry fee 9, item price 4: 9 + sum_{4 <= v i} 4 when 9 <= sum max (v i - 4) 0, else 0), which together with IC, IR, and determinism uniquely determines the two-part tariff allocation on all nonnegative valuations. Positivity of max(SREV, BREV) prevents vacuous division by zero, and both M.rev / max(SREV, BREV) >= 1.324907 and REV / max(SREV, BREV) >= 1.324907 are asserted, matching Proposition 5 completely.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.iid_lower_boundS.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:82-88 (Theorem 4, i.i.d. Lower Bound) and Setting (source-audited.tex:51-58) under SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 against the expanded Lean target for iid_lower_boundSpec and all 12 supporting declarations. The spec existentially quantifies F : FinDist for m = 40 i.i.d. copies (fun _ : Fin 40 => F), asserting 1.316 * max (SREV D) (BREV D) < REV D together with a witnessing deterministic Mechanism (Fin 40) (alloc v i in {0, 1}) whose payment rule is the exact two-part tariff with entry fee 9 and item price 4 (9 + sum_{4 <= v i} 4 when 9 <= sum max (v i - 4) 0, else 0) and whose revenue strictly exceeds 1.316 * max (SREV D) (BREV D). Combined with IC, IR, and determinism, that payment rule uniquely forces the two-part tariff allocation on all nonnegative valuation vectors. Every quantifier, constant, mechanism constraint, and inequality matches Theorem 4.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.two_sided_bracke.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:78-80 (Corollary 3, Two-Sided Bracket) and Setting (source-audited.tex:51-58) under SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 against the expanded Lean target for two_sided_bracketSpec and all 14 supporting declarations (including ValidConstants and cStar). ValidConstants is defined verbatim as {c : R | forall (m : Nat) (D : Fin m -> FinDist), REV D <= c * max (SREV D) (BREV D)}, which is nonempty and bounded below (e.g., by 1 via a unit point mass at m = 1), so cStar := sInf ValidConstants is the genuine real infimum matching the paper's definition of c*. The target asserts 2.1946 <= cStar and cStar <= 2.486, matching Corollary 3 exactly.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.universal_upper_.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:67-76 (Theorem 2, Universal Upper Bound) and Setting (source-audited.tex:51-58) under SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 against the expanded Lean target for universal_upper_boundSpec and all 12 supporting declarations. The first conjunct quantifies over every finite index type iota : Type with [Fintype iota] and every family D : iota -> FinDist, asserting REV D <= 1.1187 * SREV D + 1.367299 * BREV D (using classical DecidableEq internally, which does not alter REV or BREV because Fintype is a Subsingleton and removes any extra decidability hypothesis). The second conjunct quantifies over every m : Nat and D : Fin m -> FinDist, asserting REV D <= 2.486 * max (SREV D) (BREV D). Both bounds, constants, domains, and quantifiers (including empty-index and zero-value edge cases) match Theorem 2 exactly.
